groups.reason: Introduces ばいい against the ばよかった it is easily confused with; both forms are built from a supplied verb.
Recommend (ことだ), rule out (べきではない) or call unnecessary (ことはない) the same kind of action.
Firm conclusion (に違いない) against possibility (かもしれない) and plan-based expectation (はずだ).
Not guaranteed (とは限らない) against completely ruled out (わけがない).
Looks likely (そうだ), very unlikely (そうもない) and possible with reservations (ないことはない).

vocabulary.policy: Local displayed-form readings/glosses; no canonical word references; blank protected as grammar-target.

reviewLimits: No physical-device rendering check was performed.
Model-authored; independent model reviews recorded by the coordinator.

independentReview.method: Three blind single-facet reviews, each by a fresh agent with a different requested model family, given only the frozen render, raw set JSON, article and ledger: A linguistic correctness, B consistency and quiz safety, C learner comprehensibility. Findings were consolidated by the coordinator, applied by the author, and sent back to the original reviewers for a per-finding disposition.
independentReview.actualModelNote: The runtime does not expose the served model; the requested model is recorded.

reviews.finalVerdict: all findings resolved; no new findings

findings.claim: ことはない was an acceptable milder rebuke, not a clearly wrong distractor.
findings.change: ことはない removed as a distractor; the instruction names only ことだ and べきではない; explanations note the milder ことはない reading.

findings.claim: とは限らない was glossed as 'sometimes yes, sometimes no'.
findings.change: Now 'not guaranteed: it may be true, but it cannot be counted on'.
Rephrased contextually: the first clause grants possibility limited by the けど clause.
findings.disposition: PARTLY after round 2; resolved in round 3

reviews.finalVerdict: all findings resolved; no new findings

findings.change: Prompt adds 事故になるからだ; ことはない dropped as a distractor.
